name: Mega Footer
description: Full mega footer: white card over a soft stage with a 3-column grid (heading + CTAs + community icons, link groups, newsletter form + social row), a giant outline gradient wordmark, and a copyright row.
interactions: Link hovers: color 0.15s ease, --color-text-secondary to --color-text-primary (link lists, mini icons, social icons, legal links)
Ghost CTA hover inverts: surface-primary/text-primary flips to surface-secondary/text-primary-invert, background 0.2s + color 0.2s + border-color 0.2s
Solid CTA + Subscribe: --btn-bg-enable, hover --btn-bg-hovered, active --btn-bg-pressed, background 0.2s, inset --btn-bg-glow highlight
Newsletter input: bottom hairline --input-stroke-default, hover --input-stroke-hover, focus --input-stroke-active, border-color 0.2s
Scoped script prevents default on the form submit and all # placeholder links

layout.sectionPadding: 96px top desktop / 64px mobile, stage runs to the bottom edge
